title: Calculation Sheet — Final-Notice Paydown Amount, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Clause.** The paydown base of a final-notice paydown on the Patient Financial Account is the balance of the account's most recent statement. The final-notice paydown brings the paydown base below the placement minimum: it is the paydown base less the tier's placement minimum plus 0.01, never below 0.00, rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Quantities

| Quantity | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| balance of the most recent statement | the statement entry dated latest on the account ledger |
| paydown base | that balance |
| placement minimum | the figure of the account's financial class (the minimum past-due balance that may be placed with the collection agency) |
| margin | 0.01 |
| final-notice paydown | paydown base, less the placement minimum, plus 0.01; 0.00 if that is negative; rounded once to the cent |

Where the paydown is above 0.00, the paydown base less the paydown is the placement minimum less 0.01, which is below the placement minimum.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

1. Most recent statement 312.40 on a class whose placement minimum is 50.00: 312.40 less 50.00 is 262.40, plus 0.01 is **262.41**. The base less the paydown is 49.99.
2. Most recent statement 118.00 on a class whose placement minimum is 75.00: 118.00 less 75.00 plus 0.01 is **43.01**. The base less the paydown is 74.99.
3. Most recent statement 40.00 on a class whose placement minimum is 50.00: 40.00 less 50.00 plus 0.01 is negative, so the paydown is **0.00**.
